hook: Rice hits *₹95 a kg*. Telangana now has 12 diversion cases.
hook_b: Paying more for fine rice? Telangana has booked *12* trader cases.
tldr: Telangana stepped up rice inspections after 12 cases against traders for alleged PDS fine rice diversion, stockpiling and overpricing, as retail prices touch ₹95 a kg.

beats.what: Telangana Today: the state has registered 12 cases against rice traders and seized rice in several districts. Inspections have been stepped up.
beats.why: Traders are accused of diverting PDS fine rice, stockpiling it and overpricing. PDS rice is meant for ration card holders at subsidised rates.
beats.care: Fine rice now retails at up to ₹95 a kg, per the report. Diversion and hoarding squeeze supply at ration shops and in the market.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new (Nov 1)
cards.body: Cases rose to 12 statewide, up from six Hyderabad traders on Oct 31. Rice was seized in several districts. Exact districts, quantities and penalties were not in the report summary. Retail fine rice: up to ₹95 a kg.

cards.title: 💸 ₹95 a kg
cards.body: Retail fine rice price in Telangana, per Telangana Today. Spill's Oct 26 card had Hyderabad fine rice near ₹90 a kg.

cards.q: What would best curb ration rice diversion?
